concerns.text: T004 writes result rows to `code/data/results/` while T005–T007 write to `code/results/`. Two divergent results locations break the artifact flow: T008's `--stage verify` and T009's report generator read from `code/results/`, so T004's outputs are orphaned and the `--stage all` orchestration in T004 vs T005 writes to inconsistent roots. Pick one results directory (plan.md says `results/` at project root) and use it consistently.

T004 claims to 'run the first end-to-end analysis' producing 'real result rows', but no model or evaluation task has run yet at that point (T005/T006 are later). As ordered, T004 can only produce processed feature rows, not analysis results. Reword T004 to 'end-to-end data pipeline run' so the checkpoint claim matches what the preceding producers (T002/T003) actually emit.
